enabled.label: Levels
enabled.hint: Members earn {{xp}} for what they do here and go up a level every so often. Turned off, nobody earns any and levels are hidden; what members have is kept.

settings.levelShortHint: Shown next to pictures in the member list, e.g. "12 {{short}}".
settings.xpPerLevelHint: At 1, every {{xp}} is a level and {{xp}} is never mentioned: things earn levels instead.

showInMemberList.label: Show levels in the member list

settings.sourcesHint: Bots and webhooks never earn any. Each item turned on gives the amount beside it.
settings.cooldownHint: Messages sent sooner after one that earned some earn nothing. 0 counts every message.

replyReceived.label: Getting a reply
replyReceived.hint: Someone else replies to your message.

mentionReceived.label: Being mentioned
mentionReceived.hint: Someone else mentions you by name.

reactionGiven.label: Reacting
reactionGiven.hint: To someone else's message, once per message.

taskCompleted.label: Completing a task
taskCompleted.hint: In list channels, once per task.

voiceMinute.label: Each minute in voice
voiceMinute.hint: With at least one other person there, and not deafened.
